description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light.You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

 

Senior Industry XM Advisor - Restaurants & Retail

 

Why We Have This Role

Banks, insurers, lenders, payments processors, and fintechs capture experience data across every branch, contact center, digital channel, and claim. The hard part is getting the most from that data and turning it into action where it counts: in the branch, on the phone, and in the app. As a Senior Industry XM Advisor, you are the ongoing Experience Management (XM) partner for up to 10 financial services customers. Working closely with customer CX teams and organizational leaders, alongside internal Qualtrics account and technical teams, you will help FSI brands connect their Qualtrics programs to the KPIs they run their business on - driving impactful XM strategy, meaningful insights, and real impact from their XM programs.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Translates data into compliant operational action: In collaboration with the Qualtrics Insights Engine, uses data and insights to pinpoint the opportunities that matter most, converting findings into retention and service fixes that hold up under real-world regulatory constraints.
  • Influences without direct authority: Facilitates working sessions and insights walkthroughs with ease, building trust with CX teams, branch network heads, contact center leaders, digital teams, and executive sponsors.
  • Connects XM to the bottom line: Speaks the language of financial services operators—tying customer feedback directly to high-value customer attrition, products per customer, digital adoption, complaint volumes, and cost to serve.
  • Operates with commercial awareness: Manages 6–10 customer relationships simultaneously, proactively spotting churn risks as well as opportunities for account expansion or specialized impact consulting engagements.
  • Works smart with modern tools: Leverages AI tools to accelerate analysis and content prep work while applying critical industry judgment to ensure recommendations are accurate, practical, and compliant.

How You’ll Grow

  • Shape industry best practices: Develop and refine repeatable XM playbooks and program Accelerators that set the standard for top retail banks, insurers, lenders, and wealth management firms.
  • Expand your executive presence: Lead high-stakes strategy and annual value realization reviews and directly with customer sponsors and C-suite/VP-level operators.
  • Deepen technical and AI mastery: Stay at the forefront of XM technology by applying emerging Qualtrics capabilities and AI-driven analytics across complex, omni-channel FSI customer journeys.

Things You’ll Do

  • Tie experience programs to core business KPIs by partnering with CX and operations leaders to build and execute an annual plan focused on reducing attrition, growing products per customer, boosting digital adoption, and lowering complaint volumes and cost to serve.
  • Drive measurable service and journey improvements by analyzing overall omni-channel insights, pinpointing high-impact friction points, and recommending improvement plans and experience design.
  • Provide change management coaching to guide customer leadership and operations teams through adopting recommendations
  • Conduct XM program design reviews to ensure the right omni-channel inputs are captured to deliver insights for decision-making and business results, modernizing and evolving programs for operational action
  • Ensure high customer retention and program maturity by running a steady rhythm of monthly touchpoints, insights activation, Accelerator workshops, and annual value realization reviews that prove ROI and map out what comes next.
  • Maximize account growth and customer outcomes by partnering with Account Executives and technical teams, bringing in Qualtrics Consulting when customers need transformational, outcome-based expert-led engagements.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Hands-on CX experience as a practitioner or consultant inside a financial services organization, e.g. retail banking, insurance or wealth management.
  • 4–8+ years of XM program experience: designing or improving surveys and dashboards, analyzing results and driving action plans in financial services.
  • Deep knowledge of banking or insurance operations (branch, contact centre, claims, servicing) and the regulatory duties that shape what actions are possible.
  • A track record of turning customer feedback into changes that moved business KPIs.
  • Data fluency: comfortable with KPIs, driver analysis and dashboards; confident running insight walkthroughs in the platform.
  • A confident facilitator who influences branch, contact centre, digital leaders and senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Commercial awareness: spots churn risk, expansion and strategic Consulting opportunities, and brings them to the account team.
  • Able to manage 6–10 customer relationships at once, using AI tools to work faster while reviewing their output critically.
  • Bachelor’s degree required Master’s preferred
  • Nice to have: Consulting experience, Qualtrics platform experience, CCXP certification.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We are industry XM practitioners, not generalists: You will work alongside peers who have lived and breathed the pragmatic realities of leading XM in FSI organizations and understand the realities of regulated, multi-channel environments.
  • High-impact, long-term partnerships: Rather than handing off a strategy deck and walking away, we stay embedded with our customers year over year to see our recommendations come to life in branches, contact centres, and digital apps.
  • Collaborative, cross-functional culture: You’ll partner tightly with Account Executives, Technical experts, and strategic Consulting teams in a supportive environment where sharing playbooks and solving tough customer puzzles together is the norm.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance packages for you and your dependents.
  • Professional Growth & Mentorship: Structured onboarding, product training, and clear pathways for career advancement. 
  • Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid vacation, sick leave, and paid company holidays.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Competitive matching company contributions to help secure your financial future.
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote
